title: 驼峰里装的是什么
subtitle: 不是水，是脂肪
character: wearing a pale yellow shirt, khaki shorts and brown sandals, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel with thick waxy strokes and blended edges, sand ochre, terracotta and dusty sky blue

pages.zh:
动物园里那只骆驼，
背上鼓着两个大包。
我仰着头问爸爸，
那两个包里装的
是不是一包水。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy at a zoo rail looking up, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, asking a question; behind him stands a camel with two humps.

pages.zh:
爸爸说不是水。
驼峰里装的是脂肪，
像一大块黄油。
两个包加在一起，
有三十多公斤重。

脂肪一天天用掉，
驼峰就瘪下去了，
软软地歪到一边。
等它吃饱睡足几天，
驼峰又鼓起来了。
pages.scene: Two camels standing side by side on a cream background, one with two full upright humps and one with two empty humps flopping over. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
脂肪化开的时候，
一边放出力气，
一边还出一点水。
所以不喝水的日子，
它也能撑很久。

可它一见到水，
就没完没了地喝。
十分钟能灌下去
一百多升水，
差不多顶一大缸。
pages.scene: One camel lowering its head to drink from a long stone trough on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一百升是多少呢？
够装满十个水桶。
我一天喝的水，
连一小桶都不到，
它一口气就喝完。

沙子刮起来的时候，
它把两个鼻孔一闭，
睫毛又长又密，
像两排小帘子，
沙子就进不去了。
pages.scene: Close view of a camel's head facing the viewer in blowing sand on a cream background, its nostrils squeezed shut and its long lashes lowered. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它还有个省水的法子：
白天让身子变热，
热得受不了才出汗。
少出一点汗，
就少丢一点水。

它连带刺的枝子
也能嚼着吃下去。
嘴唇又厚又灵活，
刺扎不进去，
照样能咽下肚。
pages.scene: One camel biting a thorny branch on a cream background, its thick lips folded around the spines. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的血也不一样。
里面的红细胞
是长长的椭圆形，
缺水变稠的时候
也能挤着往前走。

它的脚掌很宽，
踩下去铺开一大片，
像四块软垫子，
所以走在软沙上
也不会往下陷。
pages.scene: Close view of one camel foot pressed onto sand on a cream background, the broad pad spread out wide and leaving a shallow dent. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我算是记住了：
驼峰里装的不是水，
是一大块脂肪。
它不是背着一壶水，
是背着一袋干粮。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy at the zoo rail nodding to himself, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, pleased; the two-humped camel stands behind him.
